title: (ר') נהוראי

paragraphs: (R.) Nehorai, in Shemuel's name, Ḥullin 55b. This requires examination, for Nehorai preceded Shemuel by much. Thus there are two: a tanna and an amora. R. Mana'ah in an elder's name—namely R. Nehorai (see R. Bizna bar Zavda).
